name: uninterpretable-keyed-lww-key-only
description: WRIT-345 item 8 (spec/fold.md §7.1, reject.go's keyed-lww key-component check): an operation that carries a non-string value at a declared keyed-lww KEY component is uninterpretable even though it never writes the declared `verdict` field itself -- op-2's `subject: 42` addresses a register, and a numeric key component is not a valid register address, so the whole operation is quarantined rather than reduced. The sibling `title` write makes the whole-op rejection observable: op-2's title write ('T2') is also discarded, so `title` stays at op-1's 'T1' rather than advancing, proving rejection is per-operation and not per-field.
